inspected_by: assistant (visual inspection of the sheet at 2-4x zoom); this is not a person's review

fields.gesture: what the drawing shows (checked against the user's order)
fields.wrist_side: where the wrist opening is, as seen in the drawing: top | left | right (the detector searches within 40 deg of it)
fields.view: palm: the palm (or the fronts of the curled fingers) faces the viewer; back: the back of the hand; side: thumb-side or little-finger-side view
fields.thumb: direction of the thumb from the hand's centre, as drawn (only where it is unambiguous)
fields.feature: the gesture's readable feature, located automatically: index_tip, thumb_tip, grip_center

r1c1.note: flat wrist cut at the top; fingers hang down; the separate digit on the image right is the thumb; no palm creases are drawn

r1c2.note: palm creases drawn; the thumb sticks out to the image right

r1c3.note: the curled fingers face the viewer; the thumb wraps across them on the image right

r1c4.note: index points image-left from the top of the hand; the thumb starts beside the index and folds down over the curled middle, ring and little fingers; the wrist side (image right) is a closed rounded outline

r2c1.note: thumb up; the curled fingers point image-right; flat wrist cut on the image left

r2c2.note: C-shaped grip opening to the image right; the single upper digit is the thumb, the curled fingers form the lower arm; the outer back of the C (image left) is a closed outline, no wrist cut

r2c3.note: flat wrist cut at the top; back of the hand seen from above; fingers down-right, thumb to the image left

r2c4.note: palm up; the fingers curl up on the image left and the thumb curls over the palm; the wrist side (image right) is a closed outline

r3c1.note: mirror of r1c1: thumb on the image left

r3c2.note: mirror of r1c2: palm creases, thumb sticks out to the image left

r3c3.note: mirror of r1c3: thumb wraps across the curled fingers on the image left

r3c4.note: NOT a mirror of r1c4: it also points image-left with the thumb beside the index on top, i.e. the same hand as r1c4

r4c1.note: mirror of r2c1: flat wrist cut on the image right

r4c2.note: mirror of r2c2: C opens to the image left; closed outline at the wrist

r4c3.note: mirror of r2c3: fingers down-left, thumb to the image right

r4c4.note: mirror of r2c4: closed outline at the wrist side (image left)
